resolutions.researcher_notes: StartYear1=2008 has a genuine, material disagreement between sources, so no settling ref is being proposed rather than picking a side. FOR 2008 (construction/mechanical completion): Wikipedia's infobox states 'Commissioned 2008' and 'Construction started 2006' (verified OK, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/East_West_Gas_Pipeline_(India) -- but its own citation for this is a now-dead gie.com link); independently, Gulf Interstate Engineering -- RIL's EPCM contractor on this project, a first-party engineering account -- states in its Wayback-archived case study 'Constructed from 2006 through 2008' (verified OK, http://web.archive.org/web/20131110102733/http://www.gie.com/experence/benchmark-projects/east-west-gas-pipeline-project). AGAINST 2008: the pipeline's current operator, Pipeline Infrastructure Ltd (PIL), states on its own live corporate site (fetched directly via curl 2026-08-10, HTTP 200; not machine-verifiable by url_verifier.py per the documented SSL 'UNSAFE_LEGACY_RENEGOTIATION_DISABLED' false-negative) 'Since the commissioning in 2009, PIL has been evacuating Natural Gas from upstream facilities of RIL, ONGC and GSPC...' -- i.e. the asset's own operator dates ITS commissioning to 2009, not 2008. A plausible reconciliation (construction/mechanical completion in 2008 vs first commercial gas flow / 'commissioning' in 2009, plausibly tied to RIL's KG-D6 field beginning first gas production in April 2009) is not confirmed by any single source stating both dates together, so it cannot be used to settle which year GEM's StartYear1 convention should record. This exact conflict was already surfaced by this row's prior deep-sweep audit (batches/india-gas/staging/ref-sweep-operating/rows/P0920.json), which likewise declined to propose a ref and flagged it for Update to adjudicate; re-verified here (both 2008 URLs still return OK, PIL's 2009 statement re-confirmed live) rather than re-litigated. Per standing rules, a value in genuine dispute does not get a settling ref from either side -- routes to Update, not this sweep. No register/PNGRB entry applies: authorisation date (21.06.2019) is not a commissioning year and was excluded per this batch's guidance.
